name: Volumetric Cloud Raymarching
aliases: Ray Marching with SDF and FBM Noise
Screen Space Ray Marching for Volume Clouds
Volumetric Cloud Rendering with GPU-Generated Noise
definition: A technique to render volumetric clouds by tracing a ray through a 3D density field, accumulating color based on density, light scattering, and transmittance.
summary: Volumetric cloud raymarching renders realistic 3D clouds by tracing rays through density fields to accumulate light scattering, differing from solid geometry by accumulating color over steps rather than stopping at the first hit.
